correctness.rationale: Cauchy–Binet gives the exact information determinant. The derivative ratio H has monotone or unimodal shape according to b≤1 or b>1; the sign pattern rigorously yields the complete global optimum. Implicit-function expansions and pair counts give critical/large-horizon behavior and equal-endpoint replication. Exact-rational and numerical tests independently check key identities and regimes, without substituting finite evidence for the proof.

value.rationale: Mandatory start/end observations plus one optional event form a natural fixed-budget sensor design. The exact damping-time threshold changes the optimal event from endpoint repetition to an interior point and the cost of repeating at long horizons grows exponentially; these are information-design consequences not implied by basic rank observability. The result is deliberately limited to this motivated constrained design.
